:::{#def-linf-space}
#### $L^\infty$ space ($L^\infty(S, \salg, \measure)$, $L^\infty(\measure)$)

Let $(S, \salg, \measure)$ be a [measure space](#def-measure-space).
For each $f$ in the [$\mathcal{L}^\infty$ space](#def-linf-function-space),
let $[f]$ be the [set](sets.qmd#def-set) of all [functions](functions.qmd#def-function) in $\mathcal{L}^\infty(S, \salg, \measure)$ that are
[equal almost everywhere](#def-equal-almost-everywhere) to $f$.
The **$L^\infty$ space** $L^\infty(S, \salg, \measure)$ (or simply **$L^\infty(\measure)$**)
is the [set](sets.qmd#def-set) of all such [sets](sets.qmd#def-set) $[f]$,
with the [norm](linear-algebra.qmd#def-norm) $\norm{[f]}_\infty \eqdef \norm{f}_\infty$
([essential supremum norm](#def-essential-supremum-norm)).

:::
